games.name: Parakeet Park
games.shortDesc: Snow has fallen down in Parakeet Park! Hop on down and chill out with your friends! Vibe to the music, Dance with the parakeets around the town that grows almost every update! Stay warm out there!
games.fullDesc: Snow has fallen down in Parakeet Park! Hop on down and chill out with up to 19 your friends! Vibe to the holiday music, Go ice skating in the middle of the town, Dance with the parakeets around the town that grows almost every update! The world is ever changing, and you'll be able to meet new NPCs throughout the town! Stay warm out there, for it is chilly!

games.name: The Forestman
games.tagline: "Turn on the headlights Terry, Harambe's coming"
games.shortDesc: Run, Hide, Fight, Or Escape. There are many paths you can go down. Which one will you choose? Stay safe from the creatures out there, its looking pretty rough.

games.name: Galaxy War
games.shortDesc:
Galaxy War is currently a game where you can hang out with friends! Visit different planets, and have fun! 
Game Is still in development.
games.fullDesc:
Galaxy War is a game where you hang out with friends and visit different planets! The lobby is the station, where you can join lobbies and change you name, color, etc. There are many roles, like admin, owner, mod, Content Creator, and beta tester that all have their own badges or cosmetics.
Game Is still in development.
